title: crypto2dev: wire wc_crypto2dev_test() into wolfcrypt/test/test.c
description: wc_crypto2dev_test() is implemented in wolfcrypt/src/port/crypto2dev/crypto2dev_test.c but has no call site in wolfcrypt/test/test.c. Without this wiring, the crypto2dev test suite never runs via ./wolfcrypt/test/testwolfcrypt. Add call under WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV guard in test.c, add the header include, and update the build system (wolfcrypt/src/include.am) to compile crypto2dev_test.c into the test binary.
